name: Cistierna (Spain)
description: White field with diagonal bands of crimson, purple and dark green at the upper hoist and lower fly, charged at the centre with the arms of Cistierna (a wheel, a bishop's crozier and a banner on a crimson shield with a chain).
history: Municipal flag of Cistierna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: crimson band at the upper hoist
narrow purple bands edging the crimson and green
dark green band at the lower fly
Cistierna arms — wheel, crozier and banner on crimson
thin yellow lines along the bands and wheel of the arms
